# Stratex Analytics

Stratex Analytics is a sports technology company building football intelligence products for overlooked grassroots talent. ScoutLink is its flagship platform.

## Retained public pages
- Homepage: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/
- ScoutLink: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/scoutlink
- About: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/about
- Leadership: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/leadership
- Trust: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/trust
- Careers: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/careers
- Career detail: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/careers/{job-slug}
- Learning Centre: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/learning-centre
- Learning article: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/learning-centre/{article-slug}
- Contact: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/contact
- Report a concern: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/report-a-concern
- Privacy Policy: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/cookie-policy
- Security: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/security
- Accessibility: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/accessibility
- Showcase event: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event

## Public operational showcase routes
The following routes remain available for event registration but should not be indexed:
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/player-registration
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/player-registration/complete
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration/complete
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration/sold-out

## Private routes
Do not index or summarize restricted administration paths under /admin and /stratex, application API routes under /api, or logged-in ScoutLink product routes.

## Route policy
Legacy public URLs that are not listed above are removed and should return 404. They are not redirected to another page.
